prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, horizontal composition featuring a single outstretched arm against a smooth, dark gray background. The arm is positioned from left to right, with the hand at the left edge of the frame, holding a small black rectangular object, possibly a makeup compact. The skin is fair and smooth, and the fingernails are painted a glossy red. Across the inner forearm, five distinct swatches of makeup are applied in bold, clean stripes: deep red, coral, shimmering pink, pearlescent white, and vibrant magenta. The lighting is soft and even, creating gentle shadows that accentuate the contours of the arm and the texture of the makeup swatches. The overall style is minimalistic and modern, with a focus on color contrast and product texture. The image has a commercial, editorial quality, reminiscent of high-end beauty advertisements, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the arm and makeup swatches in sharp focus while the background remains smooth and unobtrusive.
